name: SEO Audit
description: Full SEO audit of a site driven by .seo/profile.json: sitemap crawl (titles, descriptions, headings, canonical, hreflang, alt texts, structured data, broken links), PageSpeed Insights, Search Console indexing and performance, demand and competitor gaps — delivered as a prioritized report, a Google Slides deck and a backlog that skf-seo-pass works through.
